messages:
Maya: quick sync 94 need a last-minute bump plan for tomorrow's launch post on X and LinkedIn. low friction, high visibility.
Liam: agreed. what's the primary CTA? webinar signups or benchmark download? :thinking_face: 
Maya: prioritize webinar signups but include a subtle link to the benchmark in thread replies.
Sam: i'll queue the X thread. can we do 3 posts: morning primer, lunchtime highlight (thread), and evening reminder with webinar CTA?
Priya: that cadence sounds good. keep copy short for X, longer on LinkedIn with a single CTA and 2 asset links.
Maya: perfect. asset ask 94 can design deliver 2 static hero images + 1 carousel panel by EOD? @Sam i'll need exact specs.
Sam: specs: X hero 1200x675, LinkedIn hero 1200x627, carousel panels 1080x1080. will ping design now.
Priya: also need 2 one-liners for lead routing: 1) "Interested? Register — we'll route qualified leads to SDR queue A" and 2) "Quick demo? Book a slot — immediate follow-up from AE team." keep them under 100 chars.
Maya: routing note — leads from the webinar form should tag source=launch_bump and score via the form hidden field. SDR routing team: SDR-A handles North America, SDR-B handles EMEA.
Liam: on engagement follow-ups: we should plan a 24h nurture DM on X for people who reply to the thread, and a 48h InMail sequence on LinkedIn for commenters.
Sam: i can set the X DM copy. propose: "Thanks for the reply — want a quick demo or the benchmark PDF?" and a short link to a form.
Priya: for LinkedIn InMail, make it more consultative: "Loved your comment — we ran similar infra for a fintech — happy to share benchmarks + a quick call." keep it soft.
webinar-bot: Reminder: webinar scheduled 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC — auto-registrations enabled. Attendee limit: 500. :bell: 
Maya: timeline for posting: morning primer 09:00 UTC, lunchtime thread 12:30 UTC (this is the big one), evening reminder 17:00 UTC. Sam confirm scheduler times in Buffer.
Sam: confirmed. i'll add them to buffer and tag the campaign "sparkline-launch-bump".
Priya: bench narrative: highlight 30% token-cost reduction with caching + quantization in the first 3 bullets, then customer quote, then signup CTA. don't bury the number.
Liam: cc @Analytics — can we get a short stat line: "avg latency ↓ 18% across p95 after runtime optimizations" to include in the LinkedIn post?
Maya: @Liam i'll coordinate with analytics offline. final checklist: assets done by 18:00 today, copy locked by 19:00, scheduler loaded by 20:00. SDR routing tested by tomorrow morning.
Sam: design pinged. will paste placeholder images once uploaded to the campaign folder.
Priya: follow-up flows: 1) webhook from form to routing service, 2) tag leads, 3) send initial SDR slack alert with lead summary + transcript link (if any). add playbook link to alert.
Maya: include the playbook link in the scheduler caption too: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/launch-bump
Liam: tiny ask — can we A/B test the lunchtime thread first 2 tweets: stat-first vs. quote-first? if buffer supports, run A/B and route winners to evening push.
Sam: buffer doesn't do A/B for threads. i'll run two variants manually — Variant A pins stat on post 1, Variant B starts with user quote. we'll monitor engagement and re-post the higher performer at 17:00.
Priya: inbound lead priority: webinar attendees who also click benchmark link -> priority 1. commenters with >2 replies -> priority 2. simple rules to start.
Maya: love it. anyone object to tagging this campaign in Salesforce as "sparkline_launch_bump_q1"?
Liam: no objections.
Sam: no objections.
Priya: go for it.
Maya: ok team — i'll update the sheet and send a final check at 19:30 UTC. thanks everyone :raised_hands: 
webinar-bot: Event page: https://events.redwood.com/sparkline-launch — 142 regs so far.
